# Theme: Forest grove (active)

Brand anchors:

| Token | Hex | Use |
|-------|-----|-----|
| Forest | `#1C2B1E` | Light: text + primary buttons; Dark: page background |
| Sage | `#7A9E7E` | Light: accent; Dark: primary / highlights |
| Gold | `#E8A838` | Dark: accent (CTAs, demo) |

**Light (`data-theme="sift"`):** `#eaf2eb` / `#dce8de` surfaces, `#1C2B1E` text, `#7A9E7E` accent. Uses theme name `sift` (not `light`) so daisyUI applies this palette.

**Dark:** `#1C2B1E` surfaces, `#eef6ef` text, gold accent.

**Status (both modes, fixed):** success `#16a34a`, warning `#ca8a04`, error `#dc2626`.

Defined in `app/globals.css` via `@plugin "daisyui/theme"`.
